bull-explain.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: transparent PNG mascot sprite atlas for the Keep / Kill strategy research website. Treat the supplied UI screenshots only as CHARACTER STYLE REFERENCES, not as UI to recreate. Match the original characters extremely closely: restrained adult editorial cartoon, bold clean flat silhouettes, very subtle paper-like color grain INSIDE the figures only, minimal dark aubergine ink detail, sparse confident strokes, no thick outline around the whole silhouette, not 3D, not glossy, not emoji, not chibi, not a sports logo. All ink lines deep plum #241626. Preserve cream muzzles as opaque cream. No text, no lettering, no speech bubbles, no diagrams, no charts, no background, no floor, no cast shadows. Genuine alpha transparency throughout the empty canvas, NOT a checkerboard illustration.
Layout: a precise regular 3-column by 2-row sprite sheet on a landscape 3:2 canvas, ideally 1536x1024. Six distinct poses, one per equal cell. Every entire character fits inside its cell with at least 40px padding on all sides; horns, limbs and props never touch neighboring cells. Center each character within its cell, consistent character scale, no dividers or borders. The sheet must read as six separately usable UI cutouts. All six depictions are unmistakably the same character with consistent facial construction and proportions.
Character: the ORANGE BULL in the reference, saturated tangerine #FF681B, big sculptural long upward curved pointed horns in the same orange, long angular head, small horizontal dark dash eyes with restrained brows, cream oval protruding muzzle with two orange nostrils, angular muscular but friendly torso, simple hoof-like hands with dark tips. Maintain its sophisticated slightly dry expression.
Six poses in exact reading order:
1 top left: upper-body bull pointing LEFT with one long arm, other hand at hip, looking left.
2 top center: upper-body bull pointing RIGHT, looking right.
3 top right: upper-body bull presenting one open palm upward, confident mild raised eyebrow.
4 bottom left: full-body bull giving a small welcoming wave, relaxed standing stance.
5 bottom center: upper-body bull holding both palms outward to compare two alternatives, balanced pose.
6 bottom right: full-body bull in its neutral iconic stance, one hand at hip, other relaxed, facing slightly left.
No celebratory money, trophies or business clothing. Keep poses distinctly legible at small sizes.
